The camera focuses on the flaky texture of the pastry and the smooth ice cream. (3) Transition to a variety of food items: a burger with layers of meat, egg, and a pink smiley face; a golden bowl of steaming noodle soup with shrimp, clams, and vegetables; and a close-up of a burger filled with red sauce and green pesto. (4) Detailed shots of someone using chopsticks to lift pieces of pork and a spoon to stir the noodle soup. The lighting is bright and emphasizes the colors of the food. (6) An empty dining area is shown with green-and-white woven chairs and a large mural of a tropical forest on the wall. (7) The final shot is the exterior of the shop, titled 'ICE GREED,' featuring a mint green facade and a large window looking into the cafe.
